newsitem.title: USA: Pamet Systems says Q3 likely profitable.
newsitem.headline: Pamet Systems says Q3 likely profitable.

text.p: Pamet Systems Inc said on Friday it expects to report a profit for the third quarter and revenues of $750,000.
Third quarter results are to be released in mid-November.
The company did not disclose its revenues and earnings for last year's third quarter. Company officials could not be reached for comment.

In the 1996 second quarter the company reported net income of $193,073, or $0.08 per share, on revenues of $759,321. A year earlier it reported a net loss of $43,208, or $0.02 per share, on revenues of $335,780.
Pamet Systems designs, develops, installs and supports computer software and turnkey computer systems.
